milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining fully-grown carrot crops (age=7) drops carrot items into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 carrots, so any carrot in inventory confirms successful mining. The item ID is 'carrot' (singular) — the dropped item from the 'carrots' block.

Uses inventory_has because trading with the Leatherworker villager (4 emeralds → 1 leather_leggings) places the item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 leather_leggings, so any presence confirms a successful trade. The correct Minecraft item ID is 'leather_leggings' (not 'leather_pants').
